items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2017

venue.name: Wellington Girls' College
venue.address: Wellington Girls' College, Pipitea St, Thorndon, Wellington
venue.details: School Hall, adjacent to the main entrance

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: Kristian Muggerud has a course in solving Rubik's cube held at the school he's teaching at. The course will end in this competition, but everyone is welcome to come and compete! It will be a small competiton with 2 or 3 rounds of 3x3. The competition starts at 11:30.
